description: Receiptor connects AI agents to your bookkeeping workspace so they can find, review, and organize financial documents such as receipts, bills, and invoices. Use it to inspect workspace context, monitor intake sources, review extracted document data, check integrations, and prepare accountant-ready workflows through secure OAuth access to Receiptor AI.

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Get information about the Receiptor MCP server

tools.name: workspace_get_context
tools.description: Get the current workspace context (user, org, role, and effective ownership scope).

tools.name: workspace_switch
tools.description: Validate a target workspace and switch the active workspace for this MCP OAuth session.

tools.name: activity_search
tools.description: Search past source activity logs across email, WhatsApp, and uploads. For email sources, this first searches connected providers, then cross-checks matching message IDs against stored activity logs and returns any saved processing reasoning.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity items to return.

query.description: Natural-language or exact search query such as merchant, sender, or invoice keyword.

sourceTypes.description: Which source activity types to search.

providerResultLimit.description: Maximum number of provider search matches to cross-check before filtering activity logs.

includeSourceDetails.description: Whether to reload matching provider messages for richer email details like subject, sender, and snippet.

tools.name: approvals_get
tools.description: Get the details of a pending or resolved approval request by ID.

tools.name: approvals_approve
tools.description: Approve a pending approval request and execute the stored capability input.

tools.name: approvals_reject
tools.description: Reject a pending approval request without executing the stored capability input.

tools.name: documents_search
tools.description: Search, filter, and retrieve user's documents. Supports text search, filtering by document type, export status, date ranges, sorting, and semantic similarity. Use documents.count for totals or grouped summaries across all matching documents.

query.description: Text query (used only when useSearch=true). Omit in filter-only mode.

where.description: Typed filter clause. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists. Regex filters are already case-insensitive, so pass plain values like "grab" instead of inline flags like "(?i)grab".

archived.description: Archive filter: exclude (default, active docs), only (archived docs), include (both).

searchType.description: Search mode when useSearch=true: similarity (exact-ish) or mmr (broader)

requiredFields.description: Always include these extra fields (in addition to outputMode defaults). Allowed fields: id, merchant, amount, currency, preferredCurrency, conversionRate, date, category, docType, summary, invoiceId, receiptId, exportStatus, link.

tools.name: documents_get
tools.description: Retrieve a single document by ID with full details. Returns all extracted fields including merchant info, line items, amounts, file URL, and source.

tools.name: documents_update
tools.description: Update a single document by ID. Use this for precise corrections to extracted document fields that should not be applied through bulk edit.

amount.description: Document amount in major currency units (for example 12.34)

subtotal.description: Subtotal in major currency units (for example 11.11)

taxAmount.description: Tax amount in major currency units (for example 1.23)

changes.description: Single-document edits. Does not support fromEmail or toEmail.

tools.name: documents_list-duplicates
tools.description: List existing duplicate document groups for the current workspace.

offset.description: Number of duplicate groups to skip

tools.name: documents_scan-duplicates
tools.description: Scan active unresolved documents in the current workspace for likely duplicate groups. Read-only: returns candidate groups and recommended canonical documents without mutating data.

limit.description: Maximum candidate duplicate groups to return

tools.name: documents_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the original document file (image/PDF) with a vision model and compare visible values against currently stored extracted fields.

fields.description: Specific fields to inspect from file. Defaults to core financial fields.

maxPages.description: For PDFs, maximum pages to inspect (1-5). Defaults to 3.

tools.name: documents_count
tools.description: Count documents and aggregate data. Use for spending totals and financial analysis. Supports grouping by merchant, category, date, export status, etc. Gets ALL matching documents.

where.description: Typed filter clause. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists. Regex filters are already case-insensitive, so pass plain values like "grab" instead of inline flags like "(?i)grab".

groupBy.description: Aggregation key. Allowed values: merchant, category, docType, currency, preferredCurrency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, entityId, docDate, exportStatus. Use exportStatus to summarize exported vs not-exported documents.

archived.description: Archive filter: exclude (default, active docs), only (archived docs), include (both).

exportStatus.description: Optional export status filter before aggregation

tools.name: documents_bulk-edit
tools.description: Bulk edit documents. Supports dry-run preview (default) and execute modes. Preview returns matching documents with proposed changes and available merchants/categories for context.

where.description: Typed filter clause for targeted bulk edits. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without making changes. If false, executes the bulk edit.

labels.description: Replace labels with this exact set

shouldClearLabels.description: If true, remove all labels from matching documents

changes.description: Changes to apply to matching documents

category.description: Specific category to filter for editing

merchant.description: Specific merchant to filter for editing

documentIds.description: Exact document IDs to edit. Use this for deterministic single-document or hand-picked multi-document edits.

tools.name: documents_resolve-duplicates
tools.description: Analyze a selected set of documents as possible duplicates. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview the recommended canonical/master document first. Use dryRun=false with masterId to apply the duplicate grouping and archive the non-master duplicates.

dryRun.description: If true, preview duplicate resolution. If false, apply the chosen master/duplicate grouping.

masterId.description: Canonical document to keep. Required only when dryRun=false and must be one of documentIds.

documentIds.description: Document IDs to analyze as a possible duplicate set

tools.name: documents_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a document (receipt, invoice, etc.). The document is archived and can be recovered. Also archives any duplicate documents and cleans up cross-references.

tools.name: documents_unarchive
tools.description: Restore a previously archived document so it is active again.

id.description: The archived document ID to restore

tools.name: currency_convert
tools.description: Convert amounts between different currencies. Uses current rates by default, or historical rates for a specific date.

date.description: Optional date for historical rates (YYYY-MM-DD format). Defaults to current rates if not provided.

tools.name: integrations_list
tools.description: List available integrations for the user. Can filter by category (email, accounting, storage, social, banking) and status. Returns integration IDs needed for sendToIntegration, reconcileWithIntegration, and other operations.

tools.name: integrations_send
tools.description: Send a document (receipt/invoice) to a supported accounting integration (Xero or QuickBooks). Requires integrationId. targetId is required for Xero/QuickBooks. Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, dryRun=false to queue for sending.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without sending. If false, queues the document for sending.

targetId.description: Optional target ID from listIntegrations. Use for accounting tenants or companies.

documentId.description: The receipt/invoice document ID to send

integrationId.description: The integration ID to send to (use listIntegrations to find)

tools.name: integrations_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile a document (receipt/invoice) with a supported banking integration such as Mercury. Requires integrationId. targetId is optional for Mercury. Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, dryRun=false to queue for reconciliation.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without reconciling. If false, queues the document for reconciliation.

targetId.description: Optional target ID from listIntegrations. Use for Mercury account IDs when narrowing reconciliation.

documentId.description: The receipt/invoice document ID to reconcile

integrationId.description: The banking integration ID to reconcile with (use listIntegrations to find)

tools.name: integrations_unlink
tools.description: Unlink a document from an integration (supports Xero and QuickBooks). Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, including invoice details and orphaned attachments. Set dryRun=false to execute. This action is IRREVERSIBLE.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without making changes. If false, executes the unlinking.

exportRecordId.description: The export record ID linking the document to the integration

tools.name: rules_list
tools.description: List automation rules for the user. In Receiptor, rules, automations, and workflows refer to the same concept. Shows rule information including name, status, trigger type, and execution stats.

tools.name: rules_execute
tools.description: Create an automation rule from a natural language description. In Receiptor, rules, automations, and workflows refer to the same concept. Approval includes the generated rule details before creation.

naturalLanguageRule.description: Natural language description of the rule to create

tools.name: rules_delete
tools.description: Delete an automation rule permanently. Use this when a rule, automation, or workflow should be removed entirely.

id.description: The ID of the automation rule to delete

tools.name: rules_disable
tools.description: Disable an automation rule without deleting it. Use this when a rule should stop running but remain available for later re-enabling.

id.description: The ID of the automation rule to disable

tools.name: views_list
tools.description: List saved document views for the current workspace. These saved views can be reused by rules, automations, and workflows.

tools.name: views_create
tools.description: Create a saved document view from document filters. Saved views are reusable inputs for rules, automations, and workflows.

sort.description: Optional sort configuration for the saved view

toDate.description: Absolute to date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amountEq.description: Exact amount filter in major units

fromDate.description: Absolute from date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amountMax.description: Maximum amount filter in major units

amountMin.description: Minimum amount filter in major units

tools.name: views_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved document view. Use this when a saved filter preset is no longer needed.

tools.name: workspaces_list
tools.description: List available workspaces (organizations) for the authenticated user.

tools.name: chartOfAccounts_listAccounts
tools.description: List or search accounts from the active chart of accounts for the current workspace so the agent can ground categorization decisions.

tools.name: exports_list
tools.description: List export records with filters (document, integration, date range) for the current workspace.

documentId.description: Filter export records by document ID

integrationSlug.description: Filter export records by integration (xero, quickbooks, google-drive, etc.)

tools.name: exports_get
tools.description: Get one export record by ID for the current workspace.

id.description: The export record ID to fetch

tools.name: sources_email_enable-monitoring
tools.description: Enable monitoring for an email source to resume automatic document ingestion.

tools.name: sources_email_delete
tools.description: Delete an email source from the account and stop monitoring it permanently.

tools.name: sources_email_disable-monitoring
tools.description: Disable monitoring for an email source without removing the connection.

tools.name: sources_mobile-scanners_activate
tools.description: Activate a mobile scanner so documents from that number are processed again.

tools.name: sources_mobile-scanners_enable-ai
tools.description: Enable AI extraction for a mobile scanner without changing the source registration.

tools.name: sources_mobile-scanners_delete
tools.description: Delete a mobile scanner from the account permanently.

tools.name: sources_mobile-scanners_deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate a mobile scanner without deleting it.

tools.name: sources_mobile-scanners_disable-ai
tools.description: Disable AI extraction for a mobile scanner without removing the source.

tools.name: entities_cleanup
tools.description: Analyze and clean up the user's own business entities: enrich with Google Places data, find duplicates via place_id and embedding similarity, and merge them. This is for companies/legal entities/subsidiaries, not merchant or document duplicates.

dryRun.description: Preview changes without executing. Set to false after user confirms.

maxEntities.description: Maximum number of entities to process in one invocation

tools.name: entities_list
tools.description: List and search business entities with pagination.

search.description: Search term to filter entities by name, address, or aliases

tools.name: entities_upsert
tools.description: Create a new business entity or update an existing one.

entityId.description: Entity ID to update. Omit to create a new entity.

tools.name: entities_delete
tools.description: Delete a business entity and unlink associated documents.

entityId.description: ID of the entity to delete

tools.name: entities_merge
tools.description: Merge multiple business entities into one. Reassigns all linked documents to the kept entity, adds merged entity names as aliases, and deletes the duplicates.

keepEntityId.description: ID of the business entity to keep as the canonical record

mergeEntityIds.description: IDs of business entities to merge into the kept entity. Their names become aliases and linked documents are reassigned.

tools.name: memories_save
tools.description: Save an explicit long-term memory or preference for the current user, workspace, or document.

tools.name: memories_archive
tools.description: Archive a stored long-term memory so it is no longer used at runtime.

tools.name: memories_list
tools.description: List current long-term memories stored for the current user/workspace.

tools.name: onboarding_status
tools.description: Get the user's onboarding/setup progress including which steps are completed and what's pending.
